adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the code does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If `i.content` is `nil` for any feed item, calling `.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the poll loop. The diff adds no nil-guard or fallback (e.g., `i.content_encoded`, `i.description`, etc.), and the job is configured `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so a single bad/missing-content item would stop polling until the next run.
